entities.name: Free Labor Economy and Continued Planter Dominance
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Despite emancipation, the planter class retained ownership of virtually all arable land, forcing freed people into continued labor on sugar estates under exploitative wage conditions. Little social mobility existed for the Black majority.
